model.title: Establishing the Union Customs Code and the European Union Customs Authority

summary.text: The proposal aims to create a new set of customs rules for trade across the EU and establish a dedicated authority to manage and enforce these customs procedures. This would streamline how goods are processed and taxed when moving between EU countries and their borders.
